title: Fixture specification
description: Describes the clubs, teams, divisions and constraints for a season, for input to the constraint solver (solve.py). This schema documents the format; it is not itself consulted by the solver -- fixturespec.py parses and validates spec files independently, with its own error messages.

name.description: Shown as a subtitle banner on every HTML report page (including index.html, which recovers it from one of the other report files). Defaults to no subtitle.

draft.description: If true, the name banner (see 'name') is made prominent and prefixed 'DRAFT'.

description.description: Free-text note shown in a paragraph on every HTML report page (e.g. 'Final schedule; refer to ECF LMS for authoritative dates.'). Defaults to no note shown.

min_gap_days.description: Minimum number of days required between any two matches involving the same team. A value of 7 (the default) means a team cannot play twice within the same calendar week's spacing -- exactly 7 days apart is allowed, fewer is not.

latest_internal_match_date.description: Latest date allowed for a fixture between two teams of the same club (e.g. Hendon 1 v Hendon 2) -- useful for requiring 'derby' matches to be settled earlier in the season than the rest of the fixture list. Has no effect on fixtures between teams from different clubs. If omitted, no such cutoff is applied. Any 'fixed_fixtures' entry between two teams of the same club must not be dated after it.

avoid_dates.description: Dates blocked for every club (added to every club's club_constraints.<club>.unavailable_away_dates), so no fixture -- home or away, for any club -- can be scheduled on any of them. Useful for Christmas/New Year or other dates that would otherwise need repeating in every affected club's unavailable_away_dates. A club can still list one of these dates in its own home_dates (e.g. by oversight); it just won't ever be used, since every possible away team is unavailable that day.

clubs.description: Every club in the season, keyed by club ID (a stable key referenced from teams, club_constraints, fixed_fixtures and exclude_fixtures).

teams.description: Every team in the season, keyed by team ID (a stable key referenced from divisions, club_constraints, fixed_fixtures and exclude_fixtures).

divisions.description: Each division's fixture scheme and the teams competing in it, keyed by division number -- the only place a team's division is given. Every team listed under 'teams' must appear in exactly one division's 'teams' list, and no team ID may appear in more than one.

scheme.description: How this division's fixtures are generated. 'double_round': every pair of teams plays twice, once at each team's home venue -- the Double Round All-Play-All basis of Middlesex League Rule 7c. 'single_round': every pair plays once, with the home/away side of each match taken from the Berger table for this division's entrants, drawn in the order they are listed under 'teams' (first listed = table position 1) -- the basis Rule 7c switches to once a division has more than eight teams.

teams.description: Team IDs (from 'teams') competing in this division. For a 'single_round' division the list order is the Berger table draw: the first team is position 1, the second position 2, and so on.

club_constraints.description: Every constraint that can vary by club -- home_dates, unavailable_away_dates, max_concurrent_home_matches, home_dates_used, teams and avoid_coscheduling_teams -- keyed by that club's own ID, alongside an optional 'defaults' entry.

defaults.description: Spec-wide defaults for constraint types that support one, overridable per club. Today that's just max_concurrent_home_matches: if defaults.max_concurrent_home_matches is omitted, every club must have its own max_concurrent_home_matches entry -- there's no built-in fallback value.

fixed_fixtures.description: Pins specific fixtures (by home/away team ID) to a specific date, forcing them into the solved schedule as given rather than letting the solver choose. For each entry, 'home' and 'away' must be teams in the same division, and 'date' must be one of the home team's allowed home dates (its club's home_dates, minus any club_constraints.<club>.teams.<team>.unavailable_home_dates for that team). A fixture can't be both fixed and excluded (see exclude_fixtures).

exclude_fixtures.description: Withholds fixtures from scheduling entirely -- e.g. to arrange in a later run, once dates are confirmed -- rather than pinning them. Excluded fixtures still appear in the HTML report, at the bottom of every relevant table, with 'TBC' in place of a date.

clubs.description: Club IDs: excludes every fixture that club's teams would otherwise play within their division, in both directions.

teams.description: Team IDs: excludes every fixture that team would otherwise play within its division, in both directions.

date.description: Plain ISO8601 date (yyyy-mm-dd), quoted or unquoted in YAML.

name.description: Display name, used wherever the club is shown in reports.

home_venue_name.description: Shown in every match table for this club's home matches.

home_venue_address.description: Shown only on the club and venues pages, not in match tables.

home_start_time.description: Start time for this club's home matches, e.g. '19:30'.

home_time_limit.description: Chess time control for this club's home matches, e.g. '75+15' for 75 minutes plus 15 seconds per move.

club.description: ID of the club (from 'clubs') this team belongs to.

index.description: This team's number within its club (e.g. 1 for the club's first team). Each (club, index) pair must be unique.

name_override.description: Used everywhere instead of the default '<club name> <index>' display name (e.g. 'Hackney Herons' instead of 'Hackney 5').

max_concurrent_home_matches.description: How many home matches a club may host on the same date. Either a plain integer, null (no limit imposed by this mechanism -- e.g. for a club whose concurrency is already bounded by another constraint, such as a full set of avoid_coscheduling_teams pairings across its teams, where restating that bound as a number here would be redundant and easy to leave stale), or a mapping giving a default plus per-date overrides. A value that's simply set high enough to never bind -- i.e. >= the club's number of teams -- needs no special-casing: the solver recognises this case itself and skips adding a constraint for it.

default.description: Applies to any date without its own entry in 'overrides'.

overrides.description: Per-date overrides of 'default', keyed by date.

club_constraints_entry.description: One club's constraints, keyed by that club's own ID under club_constraints.

home_dates.description: Dates this club's teams are available to host home matches. Defaults to empty (no home dates) if omitted.

unavailable_away_dates.description: Dates this club's teams are unavailable to play away. Defaults to empty if omitted. Combined with the spec-wide 'avoid_dates', not replaced by it.

home_dates_used.description: Bounds how many of this club's 'home_dates' actually host a match in the solved schedule. Give 'min', 'max', or both. 'max' packs the club's home matches onto fewer dates (more matches per evening on average); 'min' spreads them over more dates (fewer per evening).

min.description: At least this many distinct home dates must host a match.

max.description: At most this many distinct home dates may host a match.

teams.description: Per-team exclusions, for clubs whose teams don't all share the same availability (e.g. different squads of players). Home dates are always specified at the club level above; per-team variations are supported only via exclusions here. A team not listed here just uses its club's dates as normal.

avoid_coscheduling_teams.description: Groups of this club's own teams that shouldn't be scheduled too close together (e.g. adjacent-division teams that draw from the same pool of players). Unlike 'teams' above, entries here are additive -- as many can be given as needed, e.g. one per adjacent pair of teams -- and there's no requirement that every team be covered.

unavailable_home_dates.description: Excludes these dates from this club's own 'home_dates', for this team only. An entry that isn't currently one of the club's own home_dates (e.g. a date held in reserve, commented out) is allowed -- it just has no effect until that date is added -- though fixturespec.py logs a warning for it.

unavailable_away_dates.description: Additional to this club's own 'unavailable_away_dates' -- not a replacement for it.

teams.description: Two or more of this club's own team IDs.

within_days.description: The solver allows at most one match involving any of 'teams' -- home or away -- within any window of this many days. The default, 0, means no two of them may share a date at all; a higher value also keeps them some number of days apart.

applies_to.description: Which of the listed teams' matches the limit counts: 'home' only their home matches, 'away' only their away matches, or 'both' (the default) every match they play. E.g. 'away' keeps these teams' away fixtures on separate dates while still allowing one to play away on a night another is hosting.
